scripted_metric.map_script: double left = Math.max(0, 200000 - doc["km"].value); double l = left / 100.0 * doc["litres_per_100km"].value; String d = doc["driver"].value; state.per.put(d, (state.per.containsKey(d) ? state.per[d] : 0.0) + l);
scripted_metric.reduce_script: Map all = [:]; for (s in states) { if (s == null) continue; for (e in s.entrySet()) { all.put(e.getKey(), (all.containsKey(e.getKey()) ? all[e.getKey()] : 0.0) + e.getValue()); } } return all;
